The '''Vaschean Way''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] used to serve the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vasch]]. It began at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] at [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]] and terminated at the [[Old Corellian Run]] at [[Khubeaie]].<ref name="TEA" />
